title: Fourth British thesis: the wanderer must return by renewed faith and repentance
source_text: XV. Thesis autem quarta sic habet, Dei immota ordinatio postulat, ut fidelis si exorbitans, per renovatum fidei & poenitentiae actum prius redeat in viam, quam ad viae metam, hoc est, regnum coeleste, perduci possit.
pass_a_gloss: But the fourth Thesis runs thus: God’s unmoved ordination requires that a believer, if wandering, first return into the way by a renewed act of faith and repentance, before he can be brought to the goal of the way, that is, the heavenly kingdom.
pass_b_english: God’s fixed order: a wandering believer must first return by renewed faith and repentance.
Only then can he be brought to the heavenly goal.
